name: Saffire-IV Thin and Thick Fuels with Combustion-Product Monitoring
hardware: Saffire Flow Unit (30 cm duct) plus Far Field Diagnostics
fuel: SIBAL cloth 50 cm; two-sided PMMA 18 cm x 1 cm thick
ext: Thin SIBAL: steady flame 8.5 cm (max 11 cm). Two-sided PMMA stayed alight when flow stopped (bubbling fuel jets) and soot blocked the outlet screen
sensors: Video (side and top cameras), thermocouples, radiometers, O2/CO2/CO gas sensors, aerosol monitors, remote CO2 and temperature sensors in six locations
summary: Larger fires in a reduced-height duct, with measurement of heat, smoke and gases and a test of post-fire cleanup.
key_findings: Reduced duct height roughly doubled SIBAL spread rate versus Saffire I and III
Two-sided PMMA flame persisted 15 s without flow; PMMA flame grew to 9.5 cm after 400 s
Deflagration seen at ignition on PMMA (stratified fuel vapor)
Heat release up to 10 kW; average vehicle conditions stayed acceptable (Saffire IV-V)
fire_relevance: Evidence for extinguishment strategy, smoke and gas products, and post-fire cleanup in a crewed vehicle.

name: Saffire-V Exploration Atmospheres (Low Pressure, Higher O2)
hardware: Saffire Flow Unit (30 cm duct) plus Far Field Diagnostics
fuel: Cotton jersey 50 cm; one-sided PMMA 18 cm x 0.5 cm; structured (ribbed) PMMA 20 cm x 1 cm
ext: Reducing flow to 5 cm/s for 300 s before stopping it let PMMA flames extinguish immediately; thin cotton flame regrew when flow resumed after 70 s without flow
sensors: Video, thermocouples, radiometers, O2/CO2/CO/HF/HCl sensors, aerosol monitors, remote CO2 sensors
summary: Burned materials in reduced pressure and elevated oxygen (the kind of atmosphere planned for exploration habitats) and tested ways to promote extinguishment.
key_findings: Thin fuel at higher O2 can keep burning without airflow
Reduced (not zero) airflow cooled the sample and gave faster extinction
Ribbed PMMA: flame speed depends on rib width (1-10 mm), not slab thickness
NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 does not capture low-gravity behavior of thick fuels
fire_relevance: Closest available data to a low-pressure, oxygen-enriched Moon habitat; informs material screening standards and extinguishment strategy.
